powershell_commands: # Configure PIM role settings via Graph API
# Then create specific allow policies with higher priority
# Smart Lockout is configured in Azure Portal; verify via Graph
# Intune device config for Windows logon banner
# Create Settings Catalog profile: Computer Configuration > Windows Settings > Security Settings > Local Policies > Security Options > Interactive logon: Message text/title
# Enable FIDO2 via Authentication Methods Policy
# Password Protection settings via portal; verify:
# KQL query for remote access monitoring
# SigninLogs | where IsInteractive == true | where NetworkLocationDetails contains 'untrusted' | summarize count() by UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, bin(TimeGenerated, 1h)
# Enable forced tunneling on route table
# Combine CA policy targeting admin roles with PIM JIT activation
# Create Intune Wi-Fi configuration profile with EAP-TLS
# Enable Azure Firewall diagnostic logging to Log Analytics
# NSGs have implicit deny-all; verify no overly permissive rules
# Deploy ASR rules via Intune endpoint security profile
# Intune Settings Catalog: System Cryptography - Use FIPS compliant algorithms = Enabled
# Deploy Intune device restriction profile blocking removable storage
# Settings Catalog: disable SMBv1, Telnet, PowerShell v2, etc.
# KQL: Heartbeat | summarize LastHeartbeat=max(TimeGenerated) by Computer | where LastHeartbeat < ago(30m)
# Create scheduled analytics rule for log gap detection
# KQL example for audit summary: SecurityEvent | summarize count() by Activity | top 20 by count_
# Intune Settings Catalog: Configure NTP server (time.windows.com or time.nist.gov)
# KQL: AlertInfo | where Timestamp > ago(24h) | summarize count() by Title, Severity
# KQL: SigninLogs | where TimeGenerated between (datetime(22:00)..datetime(06:00)) | where ResultType == 0 | project UserPrincipalName, IPAddress, TimeGenerated
# KQL: DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities | summarize count() by VulnerabilitySeverityLevel
# KQL: DeviceTvmSoftwareVulnerabilities | where CveId != '' | summarize count() by CveId | top 20 by count_

New-MgIdentityGovernanceLifecycleWorkflow -Category 'leaver' -DisplayName 'Offboard Employee' -Tasks @(@{taskDefinitionId='...';displayName='Disable user account'},@{taskDefinitionId='...';displayName='Revoke all refresh tokens'})
